adopt: Snapshot the coding sessions open on this machine, then reopen exactly those after a reboot, each in its own terminal tab.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
The set of sessions actually open exists only while they are running. A reboot, a crash or a closed window takes it with them, and what you get back is a list of every session you have ever had, sorted by a timestamp that does not tell you which were live. Guessing wrong opens a second view of one conversation.

Install
not published yet (pending a public repo)

Quick start
  This installs:
  1. `~/.aither/bin/aither-resume.cmd` and adds `~/.aither/bin` to your user PATH.
  2. A PowerShell profile function + `claude-resume` / `aresume` aliases
   *(best-effort — skipped if Defender Controlled-Folder-Access locks your profile).*
  3. The `/resume-all` Claude Code command in `~/.claude/commands/`.
  
  Uninstall: `pwsh -File.\install.ps1 -Uninstall`.
  
  ## Usage
synopsis: The coding sessions you had open, reopened after the reboot.
